claims.quote: Nitrogen permease regulator-like 3 (NPRL3) has been reported to play a role in seizure onset.

claims.object_text: familial focal epilepsy with variable foci (FFEVF), sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy (SHE), and temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE)
claims.quote: The principal manifestation of NPRL3-related epilepsy is a range of epilepsy-associated syndromes, such as familial focal epilepsy with variable foci (FFEVF), sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy (SHE), and temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE).
Our findings suggest that patients harboring various NPRL3 variants exhibit variable clinical manifestations.
